Done. `remove` added in todo/storage.py:42 (mirrors `complete`'s pattern), plus two tests; all 5 pass.

One pre-existing landmine worth knowing: `add` assigns ids via `len(todos) + 1`, so after a remove, a new add can collide with an existing id (add a/b/c, remove b, add d → d gets id 3, same as c). Out of scope here, but `remove` makes it reachable.
